name: tilelang-type-decorator
description: Language support for TileLang: inlay hints for buffer shapes, dtypes, and scopes.

tilelang.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter that has the tlsp package installed.

tilelang.enableInlayHints.description: Enable inlay hints for TileLang buffer allocations.

tilelang.serverArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the TileLang LSP server (e.g. --target c to set the default analysis target).

tilelang.serverEnv.description: Environment variables for the TLSP server process, merged over the inherited environment (the analyzer subprocess inherits them). The default enables TileLang data-race diagnostics; remove that entry to opt out. Custom entries replace the whole default object.

tilelang.debug.cudaGdbPath.description: Path to cuda-gdb used by the CUDA debugging command. Leave empty to use the Nsight VS Code extension's default (/usr/local/cuda/bin/cuda-gdb or PATH).

tilelang.debug.deviceDebug.description: Compile device code with -G so cuda-gdb can inspect locals and registers. Disable for faster line-only debugging with -lineinfo.

tilelang.debug.breakOnLaunch.description: Stop at every kernel launch (cuda-gdb's break_on_launch application). CUDA-GDB stops at framework kernels too; continue until your TileLang kernel is reached, or disable this and rely on Python pending breakpoints.

tilelang.debug.args.description: Arguments forwarded to the Python script being debugged.

tilelang.debug.extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the debuggee (merged over the extension's defaults). PYTHONPATH keeps the tlsp module path and merges user and inherited entries.

tilelang.debug.debugDir.description: Directory for generated debug sources, relative to the workspace folder. Defaults to .tlsp/debug.
